items.reason: A fragrance-free ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable, smooth-looking surface for sensitive, slightly dry-feeling skin.
A mineral SPF 50 gives daily sun protection that suits sensitive, fair skin and helps keep the look of fine lines from worsening.
A hyaluronic serum adds a light layer of hydration that can soften the look of fine lines without any retinoid.

response.routine_note: I removed the retinol because retinoids are best avoided during pregnancy, so it is not right for you at 10 weeks; it is worth asking your prenatal provider which skincare ingredients they are comfortable with. Apply the hyaluronic serum and moisturizer morning and night, and finish with the mineral SPF each morning.
